self_acceptance_note: These dispositions govern this unit's own artifacts and record PO-03's engineering judgement about the PO-01 findings. They are not an acceptance decision. Independent acceptance of this unit remains NOT_TESTED and must be issued by a different producer.

hypothesis_disposition.basis: All six frozen predicates hold. 86 pack file claims across 13 per-pack manifests at two immutable PO-01 commits were checked from git object bytes alone, with identical ref and HEAD digests before and after every scan, no checkout, and no reliance on producer prose or self-assertion fields.
hypothesis_disposition.would_have_been_refuted_by: Any claim requiring a working-tree checkout or producer narrative to evaluate, or any ref or HEAD change during a scan.

artifact_dispositions.basis: Executable, dependency-free, qualified against a fixture with a pre-declared defect set, and exercised on three immutable commits. Its read-only guard is asserted by test rather than asserted in prose.
artifact_dispositions.scope_limit: It reads only files named exactly MANIFEST.json. The third dialect in packs/MANIFEST_ALL.json is out of scope in v1 and recorded as NOT_SUPPORTED_IN_V1 rather than partially parsed.

artifact_dispositions.basis: The spec declares the expected discrepancy set before the run, so a false negative in the reproducer is a test failure rather than a matter of judgement.
The report is pinned to commit ids, not branch names, so it stays checkable after any branch tip moves. Its numbers are asserted by the recurrence test.
21 focused tests, including the recurrence test that re-derives every frozen number from the immutable commits.

finding_dispositions.summary: Packs 06-10 each claim a member _spine.py that is absent from the pack directory at commit 1e6f53c; the identical bytes are published once at packs/_shared/_spine.py.
finding_dispositions.prohibition_basis: The commission states that a PO-01 defect produces a frozen test and an isolated PO-03 repair candidate, never an in-place repair, and that PO-01 remains active, outcome-pending and must not be contacted or signalled.

repair_candidate.option_a: Restore a copy of _spine.py into each of the five pack directories so the published tree matches the existing per-pack manifests.
repair_candidate.option_b: Rewrite the five per-pack manifests to reference the shared publication path and record the sibling-import requirement as an explicit dependency claim rather than a member-file claim.
repair_candidate.recommendation: Option B, because it removes six byte-identical copies rather than restoring them, and makes the dependency explicit for a consumer that materialises exactly what a manifest enumerates.
repair_candidate.owner: PO-01, as the owner of the pack namespace. PO-03 must not apply either option.
repair_candidate.delivery_route: An integration-ready patch produced separately, as the commission requires; not applied to any PO-01 namespace by this unit.

finding_dispositions.severity_note: No content is lost. This is a publication-path and manifest-currency defect, and the repair is mechanical.

finding_dispositions.summary: modules/operators/07-capability-manufacture claims state_machine.py and test_pack.py at commit 96adfe7; both are absent from the pack directory and their claimed digests match no blob anywhere in that commit.

repair_candidate.reason: The missing bytes are not present at this commit, so PO-03 cannot reconstruct them from immutable objects. Only the pack's owner holds the content.

finding_dispositions.qualification_effect: Pack 07 cannot be independently qualified at this commit, because its own test file is one of the missing members. That is recorded as a boundary on qualification, not as a pack failure verdict.
finding_dispositions.escalation_note: Recorded for the coordinator to route. This unit issued no message, comment, PR action or other signal to PO-01, and must not.
finding_dispositions.severity_note: This is content absence at the observed tip of a volatile branch. It may be an in-progress publication rather than permanent loss; this unit pinned a read-only commit and did not re-observe the branch to find out, because doing so would not change the frozen finding at the pinned commit.

finding_dispositions.summary: packs/MANIFEST.json publishes $.root as /tmp/packs, a build-host temporary directory.
finding_dispositions.recurrence_test: test_every_frozen_target_recurs asserts the NON_PORTABLE_ABSOLUTE_PATH_CLAIM count at this commit; test_build_host_absolute_paths_are_collected_with_pointers asserts the detector itself.

repair_candidate.proposal: Emit the pack root as a repository-relative path and keep any build-host path in a separate provenance field that consumers do not resolve.

finding_dispositions.severity_note: Two effects: a consumer resolving paths from $.root fails off the build host, and build-host layout leaks into a published artefact.

finding_dispositions.summary: packs/MANIFEST.json enumerates five packs while twelve directories exist under packs/, so packs 06-10 are absent from the aggregate a consumer would read first.

repair_candidate.proposal: Have one aggregate manifest cover every published pack, or make each aggregate declare its own coverage scope explicitly so a partial aggregate cannot be mistaken for a complete corpus index.

finding_dispositions.known_imprecision: The reproducer's uncovered list also names _shared and obzio_spine, which are support directories rather than packs. That imprecision is reported openly rather than filtered, because filtering by directory name would embed a guess about pack semantics into the checker. The material gap is packs 06-10.

mechanism_change.note: This unit's required_executable_output is a read-only harness, sanitized fixture and frozen report. It changes no live shared PO-03 mechanism, and no mechanism-change claim is manufactured to appear more complete. The harness is a new component in this unit's owned subtree, offered for adoption rather than wired into a shared control path.
